data.case_title: Dunning for overdue electricity and water advance payments – Stadtwerke Beispielsoest
data.explanation: Your electricity/water utility provider, Stadtwerke Beispielsoest, says the advance payments (Abschläge) for October and November 2026 plus a €2.00 dunning fee are unpaid, totalling €226.00. Pay this amount by the stated date. If you don't pay, the provider says it may interrupt your electricity and water supply after giving prior notice. If you believe this is wrong (e.g. you already paid), contact them promptly with proof of payment. The letter also mentions an optional information evening on 15 December 2026 about new online services — attendance is voluntary and no registration is needed.

items.title: Pay the overdue advance payments (Abschläge) for electricity and water
items.action: Pay the outstanding total of €226.00 to the provider's account by the due date.
items.consequence: The provider may interrupt the electricity and water supply after prior notice if payment is not received.
items.quote: Wir fordern Sie auf, den offenen Betrag bis spätestens 10.12.2026 zu zahlen.

items.title: Optional information evening about new online services
items.action: No action needed; attendance is optional and no registration is required.
items.quote:
Am 15.12.2026 laden wir zu einem freiwilligen Informationsabend über unsere neuen
Online-Dienste ein; eine Anmeldung ist nicht nötig.

key_facts.label: Payment deadline
key_facts.quote: Wir fordern Sie auf, den offenen Betrag bis spätestens 10.12.2026 zu zahlen.

data.summary: Stadtwerke Beispielsoest GmbH sent a dunning (Mahnung) dated 19 November 2026 because the October and November 2026 advance payments for electricity and water were not received. It demands payment of the total outstanding amount of €226.00 (including a €2.00 dunning fee) by 10 December 2026, otherwise it may interrupt the supply after prior notice.
warnings: The letter unusually inserts an unrelated invitation to a voluntary information evening in the middle of a payment dunning; this is only informational and requires no action, but double-check any future communication about it is genuinely from Stadtwerke Beispielsoest.
